channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Underground | Hezbollah weapons tunnel destroyed in southern Lebanon
item.description: The IDF uncovered and neutralized an underground facility used to store weapons belonging to the Lebanese terrorist organization Hezbollah. During the operation, anti-tank missiles, RPG rockets, and artillery weapons were located.

item.title: Weapons cache uncovered in Binyamin region
item.description: A short while ago, a team from the Judea and Samaria District’s interagency headquarters operated in the Binyamin area and located a cache of weapons. Police bomb disposal experts were called to the scene, while a suspect who was present at the site attacked the officers and injured them. The suspect was arrested.

item.title: The new police desk leading charge against anti-Israel activists
item.description: A Judea and Samaria-based special police desk has helped deport 47 foreign activists and block 130 others from entering Israel amid a crackdown on BDS activity.

item.title: Child who went missing in Jordan River found dead
item.description: Teen found dead after rescue forces conduct extensive searches in Jordan River he fell from a boat and contact with him was lost.

item.title: Watch: Infiltrator found hiding in secret compartment in trunk
item.description: Border Police discovered a Palestinian Arab from Judea and Samaria hiding inside a concealed trunk compartment at a checkpoint east of Jerusalem.

item.title: Marla Maples says Trump carries Zohar over his heart for protection
item.description: Donald Trump’s ex-wife says the president carries an Aramaic copy of the Zohar close to his heart, while sharing details of his spiritual side and her own connection to Judaism, Israel and Shabbat.

item.title: $5 million distributed to haredi institutions that reject government funding
item.description: במעמד שנערך במעונו של הרב משה שטרנבוך בירושלים חולקו מענקים בסך כולל של כ-5 מיליון דולר למנהלי מוסדות חרדיים הנמנעים מקבלת תקציבים ותמיכות מרשויות המדינה. החלוקה היא חלק מסיוע שנתי של כ-17 מיליון דולר.

item.title: Report: Trump eyeing way out of Iran war without nuclear agreement
item.description: WSJ reports Trump could declare victory without a nuclear deal if Iran fully reopens the Strait of Hormuz and its nuclear threat remains contained.

item.title: Passengers panic as bus driver smashes window during route to Modi'in Illit
item.description: Driver allegedly lost his temper during confrontation with passenger after skipping a stop; Kavim suspended him pending investigation.

item.title: Sephora to open first stores in Israel this month
item.description: French beauty retailer Sephora will open its first stores in Israel on August 20. The initial locations will be at Azrieli Tel Aviv, Malha Mall, and Ayalon Mall, with three additional stores expected to open later.

item.title: 'No 'Fatahstan' nor 'Hamastan'': Netanyahu rejects Trump's Board of Peace 15-point plan
item.description: Netanyahu rejects Board of Peace 15-point Gaza proposal, vows no IDF withdrawal before Hamas disarmament, and rules out a Palestinian state.

item.title: Iranian media: Mojtaba Khamenei meets with Iranian President Pezeshkian
item.description: Iranian media reported that Mojtaba Khamenei met with Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian to mark three years of his presidency.

item.title: Report: Trump is considering declaring "victory" in the war with Iran - even without a nuclear deal
item.description: Report: Trump is considering declaring "victory" in the war with Iran - even without a nuclear deal

item.title: Disturbing footage: Two M16 Rifles and IDF ammunition seized in the Negev
item.description: Southern District police officers and Border Police forces operating in Lakiya and Hura seized two M16 rifles, dozens of magazines, 19 explosive grenade launcher rounds, and hundreds of rounds of IDF ammunition.

item.title: Five-year-old dies after being found in hot car in Lod
item.description: A five-year-old child was found unconscious in a vehicle in Lod and rushed to Shamir-Assaf Harofeh Hospital in critical condition, where doctors later declared his death.

item.title: 100,000 Immigrants: Nefesh B'Nefesh celebrates historic milestone
item.description: Nefesh B'Nefesh today celebrated the arrival of its 100,000th North American Oleh, a landmark achievement since the organization's founding in 2002, in a ceremony hosted by President Herzog.

item.title: Watch: Eggs thrown in Parliament as protest spirals out of control
item.description: A member of Kosovo's parliament was angered by the Prime Minister's announcement that he needed more time before naming a parliamentary speaker, and threw four eggs at him.

item.title: Likud attacks: "Fake Right"; Edelstein responds
item.description: Likud attacked Gilad Erdan and Yuli Edelstein, claiming they are working to transfer votes to the left. Edelstein responded: "We will support only the formation of a broad Zionist government."

item.title: Vehicle breaks through checkpoint, runs over spike strip, & crashes into car
item.description: Border Police officers at the Hizma Crossing signaled a suspicious vehicle to stop for inspection, but the driver attempted to flee.

item.title: New signs aim to prevent Israelis from entering Jenin
item.description: Following an attempted stoning of a mother and son who accidentally entered Jenin, new signs have been installed across northern Samaria to prevent navigation errors.

item.title: Rambam responds to accusations over treatment of wounded soldiers
item.description: Following allegations concerning the treatment of wounded soldiers, Rambam Medical Center said that every claim of inappropriate treatment is taken seriously and investigated.

item.title: Former ISA chief rejects both Palestinian state and annexation
item.description: Yoram Cohen, a candidate in Gadi Eisenkot’s party, says Palestinian autonomy could be the maximum option while opposing full annexation of Judea and Samaria.

item.title: The night at Rambam Hospital that outraged a soldier's family
item.description: Yehoshua Shani has called for an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the treatment of his nephew, who was seriously wounded in combat and hospitalized at Rambam Medical Center.

item.title: Learning to See: From Blessing to Divine Presence
item.description: Parshat Re'eh opens with “See" and ends with “be seen." What does the Torah teach us about the many levels of seeing - from physical sight to spiritual vision?

item.title: "It's a shame you didn't die": Outrage at haredi protester's words to wounded soldier
item.description: Haredim protested the opening of a café on Shabbat. During the demonstration, a civilian told the protesters, "I was wounded in Lebanon." One protester replied, "It's a shame you didn't die."

item.title: Tragedy during vacation in Mexico: Rabbi Shalom Arush's 4-year-old grandson drowns
item.description: Shalom Seginer, the four-year-old grandson of Rabbi Shalom Arush, drowned in a swimming pool during a family vacation in Mexico. He was pronounced dead after prolonged resuscitation efforts.

item.title: Inside Israel's endless manhunt for the October 7th terrorists
item.description: A special unit established after Oct. 7 operates around the clock to settle the score with Hamas militants who led the massacre, took part in it, and held hostages.

item.title: Outgoing Yahalom Commander: "The failure of October 7 is etched in our minds"
item.description: Lt. Col. H., of the Combat Engineering Corps' elite Yahalom unit, led the project to neutralize tunnels in the Beaufort area that Hezbollah had planned to use to infiltrate Israel.

item.title: If Israel was on trial and you were a juror, what would you decide?
item.description: Six claims against Israel are refuted by a United States District Judge who treats the claims as testimony in a court of law and the reader of his book as a juror. Review.

item.description: Pakistan’s Defense Minister Khawaja Asif calls for a united Islamic military front against Israel, declaring it a threat to the entire Muslim world.
